title: Сеня застаёт Федю с Мариной  (Senya Catches Fedya with Marina)

segments.t: Putting the second half of Katya's plan into action, Fedya corners Marina and kisses her right as Senya walks in. Furious at seeing his best friend kiss his wife, Senya explodes and chases Fedya across the room.
Про какой-то ещё баркас говорил, Сень.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'I do not understand, what is going on here?' Senya cuts in pointedly beside Gulya and puts the emphasis on "proiskhodit" ("is going on") in the middle of the talk.
'I did not understand either!' Gulya continues plainly around Senya and centers the thought on "ponyala" ("understood", from "ponyat") without wasting a word.
'He started kissing me himself!' Gulya speaks boldly hearing Senya, making her position completely clear.
Про какой-то ещё баркас говорил, Сень.
'He was talking about some boat too, Senya.' Pointing to the launch in this beat, Gulya leans on "barkas" ("launch, boat") to give the whole sentence its punch.
'Shut your mouth!' Addressing the mouth with Gulya, spoken Russian compresses the whole thought into just 2 words, skipping the extra helper words English needs.
'What a day this has turned out to be.' Senya opens up sharply hearing Gulya, keeping the focus on what actually matters here.
'I lost both a friend and a wife.' Discussing a friend on the spot, Senya uses "druga" ("the friend", from "drug") to make the point stick.
'Senya, stop it, help!' Stepping in frankly right here, spoken Russian compresses the whole thought into just 3 words, skipping the extra helper words English needs.
'Senechka, he started it himself!' Gulya steps in evenly with a shrug, refusing to let the moment slip past.
'Everything is fine, everything is fine.' Gulya counters evenly during the talk and lands on "normalno" ("fine, OK") as the key everyday word here.
'Senechka, my darling, little bunny, listen.' Focusing on the bunny before Senya, Gulya uses "zaychik" ("little bunny") to carry the main weight of the thought.
'Quit this job right now!' Senya fires back pointedly in their talk, testing Gulya's reaction in the middle of the exchange.
Про какой-то ещё баркас говорил, Сень.
Thrilled by Senya's fierce display of jealousy, Marina immediately forgives him and promises to quit her cleaning job right away. Until next time!
